source.note: The Official Consolidated Version on jerseylaw.je, 'compiled and issued under the authority of the Legislation (Jersey) Law 2021'. It was read on 2026-08-02 at the point in time 'Showing the law from 16 October 2025 to Current', and on 2026-09-23 the page showed the same point in time ('Showing the law from 16 Oct 2025 to Current'). The consolidated text omits the enacting formula. 'authority' is taken from the publisher's copyright page (read 2026-09-23), under which the States Assembly is entitled to copyright in any Jersey legislation. The terms are the Open States Assembly Licence – Jersey v1.0; see SOURCE-LICENSE.md. The whole-Law row legalese-full-2026-10 was made from the page showing 'the law from 02 Oct 2026 to Current', fetched 2026-10-14 and again 2026-10-26 (the paragraph text of the two fetches is byte-identical); both captures, the PDF and the amending instruments are in source/.

encodings_note: Two rows. cleanroom-2026-08 encodes the charity-test cluster only (Articles 5-7, with the Article 1 and 2 definitions it needs), written without sight of the July corpus. legalese-full-2026-10 encodes the whole Law as at 2 October 2026 (draft; no domain expert has read it; on a local branch, not landed). A third, independent encoding of the same Law exists in legalese/l4-ide as a paper case study (paper/case-studies/charities-jersey-2014/, 12 modules covering the whole Law, from the text of 16 October 2025). It is not a row here. cleanroom-2026-08/COMPARISON.md and legalese-full-2026-10/COMPARISON.md compare them.
